quotes.text: During validation of D330263 at revision 15956ae87e31, the existing description-row browser test reportedly failed twice because its older test template lacked a toggle control. This limits what a passing dialog-row test establishes for that patch. Inspect the fixture and rerun the test before attributing a later failure to the same cause.
